WITH cutover AS (
  SELECT t.id AS task_id, td.object_id AS deployment_id, tr.object_id AS package_id
  FROM tasks t
  JOIN task_targets_deployment td ON td.subject_id = t.id
  JOIN task_retires_package tr ON tr.subject_id = t.id
  WHERE t.id = 'task:catalogue-platform-legacy-cutover'
),
affected_modules AS (
  SELECT mdp.subject_id AS module_id
  FROM cutover c
  JOIN module_depends_on_package mdp ON mdp.object_id = c.package_id
  UNION
  SELECT mdm.subject_id AS module_id
  FROM cutover c
  JOIN module_depends_on_package mdp ON mdp.object_id = c.package_id
  JOIN module_depends_on_module mdm ON mdm.object_id = mdp.subject_id
),
in_scope_services AS (
  SELECT DISTINCT sim.subject_id AS service_id
  FROM affected_modules am
  JOIN service_implements_module sim ON sim.object_id = am.module_id
  JOIN cutover c ON 1=1
  JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sdt ON sdt.subject_id = sim.subject_id
    AND sdt.object_id = c.deployment_id
),
production_api AS (
  SELECT iss.service_id
  FROM in_scope_services iss
  JOIN services s ON s.id = iss.service_id
  WHERE s.label LIKE '%api%' OR s.id LIKE '%api%'
)
SELECT scb.object_id AS boundary_id
FROM production_api pa
JOIN service_crosses_boundary scb ON scb.subject_id = pa.service_id

SELECT s.id, s.label, scb.object_id
FROM services s
JOIN service_crosses_boundary scb ON scb.subject_id = s.id
JOIN service_deployed_to_deployment sdt ON sdt.subject_id = s.id
WHERE sdt.object_id = 'deployment:production'
